thread:
Aisha (SRE): Quick thought — our postmortem follow-ups keep slipping. Proposal: create a single prioritized 'Action Queue' board with SLA per action (P0=7d, P1=30d), owner, verification step, and a 'recurrence' flag. Any objections?
Matt (Eng PM): +1. Also can we auto-create tickets from the postmortem using a template? cuts down manual work.
Jules (Oncall): Agree. Need a way to tag recurring issues so they surface in weekly reviews (e.g., 'recurring:redis', 'recurring:auth').
Samir (Infra Eng): Suggest weekly 30m triage slot to batch actions, clear blockers, and reassign. Rotation: oncall lead + SRE triage owner.
Kai (Product): For comms, propose: immediate short summary to #incidents, 24h status update, then closure note when verification done. Keeps customers/internal teams in the loop.
Aisha (SRE): Draft timeline template idea: 1) detection window, 2) mitigation timeline, 3) RCA summary, 4) actions list (owner, due, verification step), 5) 30d impact re-check. Add a small code snippet for SLA defaults:
```
P0_due=7d
P1_due=30d
escalate_if_no_owner=72h
```
Matt (Eng PM): How do we enforce ownership? Suggest policy: if an action has no owner after 72h it escalates to the oncall manager; if overdue escalate weekly.
Jules (Oncall): We should also surface recurrence patterns automatically — match on error signatures / service / request path. Add a 'pattern score' to group similar incidents.
incident-bot: Incident Bot: created GH issue infra/pm-3456 from postmortem "redis-thundering-herd" assigned to oncall-rotation with due 7 days.
Samir (Infra Eng): Add a "cost of failure" estimate field to actions (SLA minutes, revenue impact, customer count). Helps prioritize.
Kai (Product): :thumbsup: If product adds ROI estimate, ops can prioritize high-cost remediations first. Can Solutions Eng own initial rollout for a month?
Matt (Eng PM): I'll draft the board columns and SLA doc (labels, triage steps, escalation flows). Aim to ship a first-pass by next Wednesday.
Aisha (SRE): SG — I'll add the timeline template to the postmortem checklist and run the first triage this Friday.
Jules (Oncall): I'll update the oncall rotation doc to include the weekly triage slot and escalation contact list.
Matt (Eng PM): One last ask: add a quick 'verification checklist' field to each action so owners mark how they confirmed fix (metrics, canary, smoke test).
Aisha (SRE): Good call. Verification steps will be required to close an action.
Samir (Infra Eng): I'll prototype the recurrence detector query and share results in #eng-metrics.
Kai (Product): Thanks all — this feels actionable.
Jules (Oncall): Thanks — pinging @everyone in #eng-oncall once the board exists.
